title: Author the cli build-type template
description: Create templates/cli/template.json (valid against template.schema.json, listing required_files) and templates/cli/files/ with package.json, README.md, .gitignore, src/index.js, test/index.test.js using {{slug}} and {{summary}} placeholders. Content authoring; a test asserts the manifest is valid and required_files match the files/ tree.
acceptance_criteria: templates/cli/template.json validates against template.schema.json and lists required_files.
templates/cli/files/ contains the listed files, using only the documented {{slug}}/{{summary}} placeholders.
A test asserts the manifest is valid and required_files match the files/ tree; full suite passes.
